description: Sets the border to the cell / cell range with the parameters specified.

params.description: Specifies the line style used to form the cell border.
params.name: lineStyle

params.description: The color object which specifies the color to be set to the cell border.
params.name: oColor

returns.description: returns true if the borders were set successfully.

signature: SetBorders(bordersIndex: BordersIndex, lineStyle: LineStyle, oColor: ApiColor): boolean
